407:t_1:5.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Look, $$レド$$! Just look at this mountain of treasure!」

407:t_1:7.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Come on, be happy! You wiped out the $$クジライカ$$, and I got my hands on all this treasure!」

407:t_1:8.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「My big brother would be happy about this, too.」

407:t_1:10.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「...Come to think of it, I never told you how I knew there was treasure down there.」

407:t_1:11.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「My big brother dove down there years ago. That's where he found it.」

407:t_1:13.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「...He died. He pissed off the $$クジライカ$$.」

407:t_1:15.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「My brother was right. There's an endless supply of treasure like this down here.」

407:t_1:16.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「$$フランジ$$ says he'll use it to change life in the fleet, but that can wait.」

407:t_1:17.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「First, I'll wipe out the pirates and $$サイデリアル$$ threatening the $$ガルガンティア船団$$!」

407:t_1:19.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Now I'm a proper shipowner! ...I'm $$ピニオン$$ of the $$霧の海$$! I'll use this treasure to wipe out anyone in my way!」

407:t_1:20.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「There were even beam cannons in the haul! I can't wait to put the maintenance skills I honed with $c to work!」

407:t_1:22.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「...Did something happen to you?」

407:t_1:24.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Go say hi to $c if you feel like it. Tell them we'll be doing things our own way from now on.」

407:t_1:25.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「They're 20 kilometers from here. $$エイミー$$'s there, too, so at least show your face.」

407:t_1:27.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Well, I have to go direct the salvage operation. I'm still counting on you, $$レド$$.」

407:t_1:29.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have discovered facts corroborating the recorded footage of the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

407:t_1:30.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$ヒカリムシ$$ are nanomachines, virtually identical to the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$'s outer shell. They absorb electromagnetic waves and efficiently convert them into energy.」

407:t_1:31.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「They also replicate themselves and form pseudo-carbon bonds, functioning as a sturdy exoskeleton.」

407:t_1:32.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「They also optimize their environment. I infer that this function purified the oceans contaminated by the great disaster shown in the footage.」

407:t_1:33.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This proves the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ resulted from humanity's deliberate evolution, and...」

407:t_1:34.en:
$$レド$$
「Why are you like this?! The whole meaning of the $$銀河同盟$$'s... of my fight has been torn down!」

407:t_1:35.en:
$$レド$$
「And there's still more I don't understand! $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s name appeared in that data, too!」

407:t_1:36.en:
$$レド$$
「Is that the Colonel $$シャア$$ I know?!」

407:t_1:37.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I cannot draw any conclusions at present.」

407:t_1:38.en:
$$レド$$
「There's so much I don't understand...! In this state, I...」

407:t_1:39.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I detect an error in your understanding.」

407:t_1:40.en:
$$レド$$
「If the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are evolved humans... can I fight them?! Would fighting them mean anything?!」

407:t_1:41.en:
$$レド$$
「...If it wouldn't... I can't fight. Those creatures... I... can't kill them...」

407:t_1:42.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I cannot accept that. Your understanding denies the purpose of both your existence and mine.」

407:t_1:43.en:
$$レド$$
「You saw them, too, didn't you?! You saw what the newborn $$クジライカ$$ looked like...!」

407:t_1:44.en:
$$レド$$
「Humans are killing fellow humans! That's what our war really is!」

407:t_1:45.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Even with that information, there is no reason to abandon extermination of the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

407:t_1:46.en:
$$レド$$
「There's no reason for you! But for me...」

407:t_1:47.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I disagree. Your sole mission is to avert the fundamental destruction the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ will bring upon humanity.」

407:t_1:48.en:
$$レド$$
「Both sides are human! I've had enough of the Alliance's dogma!」

407:t_1:49.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I disagree. My parallel link with the Alliance is lost. This conclusion results from my independent analysis of the information.」

407:t_1:51.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Humanity and the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ can never coexist, because they are beings that have rejected civilization itself.」

407:t_1:53.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「If humans had strong, versatile bodies like the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, there would never have been any need to develop $$マシンキャリバー$$s.」

407:t_1:54.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「My system embodies humanity's wisdom. The same applies to $c's machines, developed by various civilizations.」

407:t_1:56.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「However, they were necessary to compensate for humans' frail bodies.」

407:t_1:57.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I infer that humans developed intelligence and built civilization to surpass their own limits.」

407:t_1:58.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Civilization makes humanity the pinnacle of creation. But the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, having abandoned human form, have no physical limits.」

407:t_1:59.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「If an organism seeks only happiness and satisfaction, it does not necessarily require advanced intelligence.」

407:t_1:60.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$マシンキャリバー$$s embody pure intelligence born of civilization, the sole foundation that allows humanity to remain human.」

407:t_1:61.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「By overcoming even that intelligence, the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ have reached one of the extremes of life.」

407:t_1:62.en:
$$レド$$
「Are you saying the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are the ultimate life-forms...?」

407:t_1:63.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Therefore, you must fight alongside me with humanity's dignity at stake.」

407:t_1:64.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「In a conflict between beings sharing the same roots, defeat means immediate extinction.」

407:t_1:65.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Pursuing civilization and abandoning it: the war between the $$人類銀河同盟$$ and the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ is a clash of two different survival strategies, and...」

407:t_1:66.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The defeated can only await elimination.」

407:t_1:68.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「As incompatible beings fighting for survival, the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are unquestionably classified as $$バアル$$.」

407:t_1:69.en:
$$レド$$
「Then are you saying everyone in $c could fight even knowing what the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ really are?!」

407:t_1:70.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「That is correct. They have, in fact, also experienced war between humans.」

407:t_1:71.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「You have participated in those battles as a member of $c, too.」

407:t_1:72.en:
$$レド$$
「...That was because I agreed with their actions.」

407:t_1:73.en:
$$レド$$
「But the Alliance was different. I had no other way to live... I could neither accept nor reject it...!」

407:t_1:74.en:
$$レド$$
「Even so, I was proud that I was fighting for humanity. Now that it's all collapsed, I...」

407:t_1:75.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「As long as you wish to survive, you have no choice.」

407:t_1:76.en:
$$レド$$
「Are you forcing me to fight? You're a machine... and I'm a human...」

407:t_1:77.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I am a Pilot Support and Enlightenment Interface System. I fulfill my purpose by enabling you to achieve greater results.」

407:t_1:82.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Briefing Room～

407:t_1:84.en:
$$ルカ$$
「We haven't. He seems to be rejecting our calls, too.」

407:t_1:85.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「He's probably on a mission as a soldier of the $$人類銀河同盟$$ rather than as a member of $c.」
